# Corporate Academy

> Corporate Academy is a professional technology training and certification institute offering instructor-led online and self-paced courses across IT, business, and management disciplines. We serve working professionals, fresh graduates, and corporates across India and globally.

## Live, always-current summary

Course counts, category listings, and training stats change as our catalog grows.
For the up-to-date, machine-generated version of this file (built from the live
course database), fetch:

https://corporateacademy.com/api/llms.txt

The full course URL list is available at:

https://corporateacademy.com/api/sitemap.xml

## Non-changing brand facts

- Founded as a professional training institute serving India and global learners
- All courses taught by industry practitioners from Big Four consulting firms, Fortune 500 companies, and leading technology organizations
- Certifications are globally recognized and accepted by 10,000+ companies worldwide
- Live online classes + self-paced learning options
- Scholarship programmes available (up to 50% off)
- Corporate training packages for teams and enterprises
- Doctorate / DBA programmes awarded by accredited international partner universities
